title: TechNova cuts its sponsorship by 40%
subject: Update on our sponsorship
body:
Hi team,

Due to a revised marketing budget at our end, we need to reduce TechNova's sponsorship from ₹1,00,000 to ₹60,000. Please send us the updated deliverables by Nov 21.

Regards,
Priya, TechNova Labs

title: TechNova cuts its sponsorship by 70%
subject: Urgent: TechNova Sponsorship Revision
body:
Hi organizers,

Following our board review, we have to cut back all external festival commitments. TechNova can now only contribute ₹30,000 instead of ₹1,00,000. Please confirm deliverable revisions by Nov 19.

Best,
Priya, TechNova Labs

title: GreenByte cuts its sponsorship by 50%
subject: GreenByte Silver Tier Adjustment
body:
Hello team,

Due to unexpected cashflow delays this quarter, GreenByte is revising our silver sponsorship from ₹30,000 to ₹15,000. Please let us know the revised lanyard and booth arrangements by Nov 25.

Thanks,
Arun, GreenByte

title: TechNova raises its sponsorship by 50%
subject: Exciting news: Upgrading our sponsorship
body:
Hi team,

Great news from our marketing committee! We have approved an expansion of TechNova's sponsorship from ₹1,00,000 to ₹1,50,000. Let's discuss adding title sponsorship perks by Nov 28.

Regards,
Priya, TechNova Labs
